value.rationale: The primary paper leaves the same-exponent Schatten limit open beyond selected classes. Two-sided compact shifts cannot in general be decomposed as unilateral reducing summands, and summable weights can fail every smaller-Schatten hypothesis. The all-parameter tail inequality gives an explicit mechanism for endpoint convergence; the all-cycle/path formula provides a natural complete classification for partial permutations. The plateau obstruction shows quantitatively why convergence lacks a uniform rate. This is a motivated infinite-dimensional structural finding rather than a routine finite test.
